entities.name: JobMap
observations: Primary orchestration component for both Work History and Job Search map modes. File: src/components/job-map.tsx.
Accepts optional props: initialMode ('work-history' | 'job-search') and lockedMode (boolean). Both backward-compatible.
When lockedMode=true: passes onToggleWorkHistory={undefined} to JobMapGoogle, hides the 'Work History' button in the action bar, and disables mode-switching.
Entry points: WorkHistoryMap wrapper (/work-map route) and JobSearchMap wrapper (/job-search route). Also used directly in legacy contexts.
2026-06-02: lockedMode and initialMode props added to support separate dedicated routes.
